text:
这是按作者口径修改后的 4 页，请只判定这 4 页：
- 第 2 页：痛点「点不中 7 毫米控件」改为「触点很容易偏」，看断行是否自然；
- 第 3 页：第 2 条由「无触摸按键」改为「双键交互」，说明变长，看是否单行放得下、不压右侧设备；
- 第 4 页：左侧「呈现」行改为「双键操作」，右侧第 2 条改为「双键交互 / 地图选点交给手机…」，看是否溢出；
- 第 10 页：「传输」行删掉 15 KB/s，改为「蓝牙传 GPX / 小文件，CRC32 断点续传；大包走 MTP」，看是否单行或自然换行。

PNG：/home/jinsc/SDK/vela/ppt/.build/render6/s-02.png、s-03.png、s-04.png、s-10.png。

每页一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""}，最后一句说明。

thinking: Let me read the four assigned page images one by one and judge them.

Page 2: the pain point item 02 手套 now says "骑行手套、雨水、汗水，触点很容易偏。停车摘手套，节奏就断了。" The line break: "骑行手套、雨水、汗水，触点很容易偏。停车摘手套，节奏就" / "断了。" The second line is just "断了。" — two characters orphaned on the second line. Is that a natural break? The requested text was changed to "触点很容易偏". The line break produces "节奏就断了。" split as "节奏就" ending line 1 and "断了。" on line 2. That's a somewhat awkward orphan but is it a defect? The dispatch asks: 看断行是否自然 (check if line break is natural). A 2-character orphan "断了。" on the second line — in Chinese typesetting, a line with only 2-3 characters is generally considered acceptable but not ideal; it's common. Is it "natural"? The break "节奏就 / 断了。" splits mid-phrase but Chinese wraps character-by-character generally, so it's normal. Two characters on last line is a short orphan but acceptable in Chinese text. Hmm, the coordinator explicitly asks to check whether the break is natural. The second line "断了。" — actually it's "断了。" three characters including the period. That's a fairly typical Chinese wrap. I would call this acceptable — Chinese doesn't have strict widow/orphan rules like Western typography. It reads naturally. Verdict: pass.

Let me look more carefully at the image. Line 1: "骑行手套、雨水、汗水，触点很容易偏。停车摘手套，节奏就" Line 2: "断了。" Yes. That's fine.

Page 2 layout otherwise fine: three items with separators, right column headline. No overlap. Pass.

Page 3: item 02 "2 颗 / 双键交互 / 短按翻页，长按开始 / 暂停；戴手套也能按，翻页一步到位。" The description is on a single line and ends well before the right device image (device starts around x=1510; text ends around x=1100). No overlap, no wrap. Pass.

Page 4: Left "呈现" card: "2.4" 240×320 半透半反 · 双键操作" and "microSD（地图 / 轨迹） · BLE 5" — fits on one line each, within card. Right column item 2: "双键交互 / 地图选点交给手机；车上只保留翻页和开始 / 暂停" — one line, ends at x~1770, within column width (column ends ~1895). No overflow, no wrap. Pass.

Page 10: "传输" row now reads "蓝牙传 GPX / 小文件，CRC32 断点续传；大包走 MTP" — single line, ends around x=845 within the left column (~940). No 15 KB/s present. No overlap with the divider column at x~960. Pass.

All four pass. Output format: coordinator asked {"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":[],"fix":""} plus a final sentence. My system prompt format says issues entries have category/problem/evidence, but coordinator's requested schema overrides for the reply shape? The system says output one JSON line per page with that format. The coordinator asked for issues:[] and fix:"". I'll follow the coordinator's schema since it's compatible, keeping issues empty for passes. All pass, so issues empty anyway. Final sentence in Chinese.
